oracle.name: least_loaded_hot_container_oracle
oracle.objective: minimize weighted load while respecting online status, task support, and query constraints
notes: network_latency is fixed to 1 in all states and is intentionally ignored
nodes are excluded when either node_id or platform matches an exclude_nodes constraint
nodes are allowed only when node_id or platform matches require_node or require_nodes constraints
